concept.name: Corporate Carbon Disclosure Reconciliation Desk
concept.targetBuyer: ESG assurance analysts, sustainability reporting teams, and accounting reviewers
concept.buyerProblem: Public corporate energy and emissions disclosures are often embedded in filings with inconsistent layouts, units, factor years, and levels of detail, making it costly to determine which figures can be reproduced and which require human follow-up.
concept.centralClaim: A bounded reviewer-operated proof can extract declared company-level energy and emissions figures from a small, licensed set of public filings, preserve page-level provenance, normalize units, and reproduce only calculations supported by explicit activity and factor evidence while routing insufficient or contradictory disclosures to review.

authorizedScope: Human-approved bounded vertical proof for Candidate A: complete the source contract, select no more than three permitted public SECR filing documents, freeze the project-local validation plan before implementation, and build/test a six-case reviewer proof with local JSON/CSV evidence. No expansion, hosting, paid services, publication, regulatory-compliance claim, or delegated research/build work is authorized. Earlier publication approvals do not transfer to WS-004.
nextAction: Request explicit human expansion approval before building the reviewer web UI, project-specific three-page visual PDF, public hosting, or release evidence. Independent non-builder validation and the executable hash gate remain mandatory after an approved stable candidate.

humanApproval.basis: The user replied 'Approved!' to the WS-004 Candidate A recommendation and four-turn delegated-agent ceiling. This authorizes the bounded source-contract check and vertical proof only; expansion, hosting, and publication remain unapproved.

limitations: No client posting was supplied. Demand evidence is indirect and inherited from the recorded public-preliminary market matrix; it does not prove demand for this exact service.

The Companies House Document API requires an API key and is unavailable in its sandbox. The approved proof instead uses one bounded official free Accounts Data Product archive; no credential is required or requested.
The proof would assess reproducibility and evidence sufficiency, not certify emissions, legal compliance, audit assurance, or company truthfulness.
Only company-level metrics may be retained or displayed; personal names, signatures, contact details, and unrelated filing content are out of scope.

agentBudget.allocationPlan: The validator and one repair recheck are reserved before any research/build agent. No research or build delegation is planned; root will perform a bounded proof if approved. Any use beyond four turns or any second repair pass requires new human approval.
